text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp, haaaah*—!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu, haa, huee*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having undeniably given it their absolute 
all, the two receive a generous round of 
applause from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines... thank you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't pulled me forward, I don't 
think I could have run this far.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, thank YOU, Ryan-chan♪ You really are 
the best!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because you chased after me, Ryan-chan, I 
was able to push myself way past my 
limits!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. I'm sorry for making you 
worry so much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
After this Derby, I finally understand. 
This is no time for me to be burning out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Because such a wonderful race is waiting 
for me!!
choice_data_list: We still have one crown left, after all.
We still have one crown left, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I don't know what kind of race the 
Kikuka Sho will turn out to be. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become able to run even better 
than I did today!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
As for me~... I don't think I can push 
past this today~. Look, my legs are 
already so wobbly~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm gonna get even closer with 
Ryan-chan than today. As Friend A♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Nobody thinks of you as just 
"Friend A," Ines.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Warm laughter fills the air of Fuchu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the green leaves of the great 
zelkova... every single one of the 
thoroughbreds shone brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I watch it, it 
was a truly magnificent race, Ryan. So 
this is... who you are now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To me, it's still a distant place... But—

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
Race 9, featuring McQueen-san, is about to 
begin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I will be right there. Immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The seasons cycle by so quickly. The great 
trees put on their colors —in the deepest 
days of autumn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A sleeping master performer chases Mejiro 
Ryan from behind. The Classic campaign—is 
still only halfway through.
